 Advocate for : MR. B U LASKAR  Advocate for : SC  REVENUE appearing for THE STATE OF ASSAM AND 4 ORS
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN DEV CHOUDHURY  ORDER 11.09.2024 1.
Heard Mr. R. M. Das, learned Standing Counsel for the applicant/Water Resources Department.

Also heard Ms. U. Das, learned State counsel representing the State respondent and Mr. B. U.
Laskar, learned counsel for the writ petitioners.
Page No.# 1/12 vs Rushan Ahmed Barbhuiya And 22 Ors on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146249384/

8 2. This Court under its order dated 02.08.2024 passed in IA(Civil)/1964/2024, observed the following:-
3. A direction was issued to the learned standing counsel of Water Resource Department as well as to Ms. Barman to obtain instruction whether the house of the petitioners are standing in patta land and whether in course of construction said house is to be demolished and whether any land of the petitioners have been used in the construction of the dyke.
4. Pursuant to the same, the Additional District Commissioner cum CEO, DDMA, Hailakandi has furnished the instruction to Ms. Barman, learned Junior Government Advocate by its communication dated 01.08.2024, which discloses that Ratanpur Part-II and Bahadurpur Part-II fall under periodic patta land the names of the petitioners have been included in the zirat compensation beneficiaries list as per assessment report of the concerned ASO.
The Page No.#

10/12 communication of the Circle Officer on the basis of which such fact communicated to Ms.
Barman reflects that the land in question are patta land and at this stage possession of the petitioners without conducting field verification are not possible as LR assistance are engaged in time bound Government project i.e. verification of digitized settlement map.
The list of beneficiary of zirat compensation is also annexed along with the said document.
The names of the petitioners also find in the list forwarded to Ms. Barman, which discloses that the petitioners find place for zirat compensation for houses.
5. However, from the aforesaid position, it is clear that no land acquisition process has been initiated.
Such fact has also been ascertained by Ms. Barman.
Though, zirath proposal has already been submitted to the department, however, such payment has not been made.
6. Therefore, this court is of the prima-facie view that the dyke was constructed over the patta land without following any due process required to be followed under the Land Acquisition Act .Though
some assessments were made for payment to zirat, however same has not been paid.
Such course of action is not permissible under law inasmuch as right of a person can be taken away without following due process of law and in this case the due process of law.

7. Balancing the equity, it is provided that till the next date of listing, the houses of the petitioners should not be demolished inasmuch as till date no zirat have also been paid to the petitioners against the houses.

In the meantime, affidavit be filed by the State respondents as well as by the requiring department under what circumstance while constructing the dyke, acquisition process have not followed, and if followed the details thereof".
3. The present application is filed seeking modification of the aforesaid order dated 02.08.2024 passed in IA(Civil)/1964/2024, expressing that it involves important public project.
4. A specific stand has been taken by the requiring Department/applicant that the Page No.# 11/12 project is
very important
inasmuch as it is construction of road cum dyke.

According to Mr. Das,
learned Standing Counsel, the dyke is more important for protection of the nearby villagers from flood and erosion.
Page No.# 1/12 vs Rushan Ahmed Barbhuiya And 22 Ors on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146249384/

9 5 . It is the further contention of Mr. Das, learned Standing Counsel for the requiring department/applicant that a joint survey was conducted by the Circle Officer of Hailakandi Revenue Circle and Assistant Settlement Officer, Algapur Circle and accordingly, a land availability certificate was issued on 23.11.2022 and on the basis of such land availability certificate, the project was sanctioned and already 63% of physical progress has been achieved so far.
6.

It is a specific contention of Mr. Das, learned Standing Counsel for the requiring department/applicant that department had also made application before the Deputy Commissioner,
Hailakandi for demarcation of land available for dyke from Boroitoli to confluence of river Katakhal by their letter dated 06.02.2023 followed by another letter dated 14.03.2023.
It is also their contention that the contractor could not execute the work for the reason that entire dyke is encroached by the encroachers.
7. Thus, the stand of the Deputy Commissioner, stand of the respondent department and the stand of the petitioners are contradictory.
On the one hand, the requiring department submits that they have been certified as regards availability of land and therefore, they continued with the project and there are encroachments.
At the same time, the Deputy Commissioner take a stand that the land where the petitioner's houses were standing are patta land.

According to the Deputy Commissioner,
pursuant to communication dated 06.02.2023 and 14.03.2023 of the department, the Deputy Commissioner has responded and even has submitted the report on damage assessment and the required compensation.
However, thereafter also, no communication is forthcoming from the respondent department.
Therefore, it could not proceed with the land Page No.# 12/12 acquisition process.

8. Thus, two stands are there; (i) that there is encroachment and no acquisition is required and (ii)
the land of the petitioners are patta land and therefore, demarcation should be required.

9. In the aforesaid backdrop, before considering vacating/modifying the interim order dated 02.08.2024 passed in IA(Civil)/1964/2024, this Court would like to have a clarity on the status of the land.

Accordingly, it is provided that both the authorities i.e. the Collector and the Water Resources Department may sit together and resolve the issue and affirm whether the patta land of the petitioners shall be required for the construction of the dyke and / or whether the construction of dyke shall damage the properties of the petitioners standing over any private patta land.

10. List this matter on 25.09.2024.
11.
Interim order passed earlier in IA(Civil)/1964/2024 shall continue till then.

opennyai_summary.facts:

5. However, from the aforesaid position, it is clear that no land acquisition process has been initiated.
6. Therefore, this court is of the prima-facie view that the dyke was constructed over the patta land without following any due process required to be followed under the Land Acquisition Act .Though
some assessments were made for payment to zirat, however same has not been paid.
Such course of action is not permissible under law inasmuch as right of a person can be taken away without following due process of law and in this case the due process of law.

inasmuch as it is construction of road cum dyke.

8. Thus, two stands are there; (i) that there is encroachment and no acquisition is required and (ii)

opennyai_summary.arguments: It is also their contention that the contractor could not execute the work for the reason that entire dyke is encroached by the encroachers.
opennyai_summary.decision:
9. In the aforesaid backdrop, before considering vacating/modifying the interim order dated 02.08.2024 passed in IA(Civil)/1964/2024, this Court would like to have a clarity on the status of the land.
Accordingly, it is provided that both the authorities i.e. the Collector and the Water Resources Department may sit together and resolve the issue and affirm whether the patta land of the petitioners shall be required for the construction of the dyke and / or whether the construction of dyke shall damage the properties of the petitioners standing over any private patta land.
10. List this matter on 25.09.2024.
11.
Interim order passed earlier in IA(Civil)/1964/2024 shall continue till then.
